name: dsh-message-revert
description: DSH message revert/rollback plugin: a revert button on every sent message; on confirm it restores the message text and attachments to the composer, rolls the session back (fork at the last completed turn, or a fresh blank session for a first message) and restores workspace files to their captured before-content. Host engine + browser UI, no core changes.

scripts.bundle: echo noop: plain JS host+client plugin; edit lib/ directly
